lead: A literal query whose `?` count does not match its values is a compile error, so a hostile case cannot catch it.
body: The compiler binds a literal statement with the request's own rewriter and raises `E0770` there, so the mismatch never reaches run time, and a hostile case holding one is a compile diagnostic — which `rule:testing/hostile-case-contract` counts as a failure. Build the statement while the program runs — `'insert into t (a) values (?' . Core\Str::repeat(', ?', 2) . ')'` — whenever the refusal itself is the attack.
